transcript: Run H3 at the D3h conical intersection of 1.52 Angstroms and show the degenerate e-prime orbitals.
narrative: At the **H₃ D₃ₕ Conical Intersection (R = 1.52 Å)**, the electronic manifold exhibits a 3-orbital degenerate active space. The three active-space natural orbitals displayed in your top panel comprise the totally symmetric **a₁'** orbital and the strictly degenerate crossing pair **(e'_x, e'_y)**. While conventional single-determinant Hartree-Fock suffers unphysical Jahn-Teller symmetry breaking, Q-BOLTZ phase-space kinetic transport rigorously preserves D₃ₕ spatial symmetry, relaxing natural occupations to `[1.9949, 0.5025, 0.5025]` with an informational correlation entropy of **3.3043 bits** and total energy of **-30.8495 eV**.
